messages:
nicole-recruiter: Quick heads-up: Candidate (S. Osei) flying in, flight delayed to land at 11:45am. Their first on-site panel is 12:30pm. They asked if we can switch to an afternoon schedule or do remote for the morning, and whether we can arrange a quiet check-in and lactation-friendly lunch (they have dietary restrictions). Also asked if we can reimburse a rideshare from the airport if they miss the shuttle.

leo-peopleops: We can pivot. Remote fallback ready. We also have Quiet Room 1B for check-in. If they prefer in-person and arrive late, we can bump afternoon interviews. What time can panelists be flexible? @maria-hiringmgr @anya-panel

maria-hiringmgr: I can move my 12:30 to 2pm. Anya?

anya-panel: I can do after 1:30. If needed I'll host the coding session remotely.

carlos-it: Loaner available (LOANER-4421) with USB-C + HDMI. I'll leave it at reception at 1:00pm. Also will include a USB-C to compact keyboard adapter.

facilities-bot: Quiet Room 1B reserved 12:00-15:00. Shuttle override: if candidate misses company shuttle, we can approve rideshare up to $60. Badge hold placed.

recruiting-bot: Add note in ATS: "candidate flight delay - offer remote AM slots. LOANER-4421 reserved."

leo-peopleops: Reimbursement: receipts to people-ops@redwood.ai subject "Candidate Expense - Osei". We'll expedite. Also catering team will prepare lactation-friendly boxed lunch.

nicole-recruiter: Candidate opted for remote in the morning and will try for in-person in the afternoon. I'll DM them the Zoom link and confirm they saw the loaner pickup time. Will update after morning loop.

maria-hiringmgr: Thanks team. Please ping if they can make afternoon in-person so we can re-open room reservations.

nicole-recruiter: Update - candidate completed morning remote loop and will try to arrive by 1:45pm. I'll confirm arrival and pickup code for LOANER-4421.
